decision: Approve bounded MaverickX team-preview setup after source review and acceptance; do not authorize production publication or team notification

preview.namespaceStatus: Not created; capture assigned ID after approval and bind only that verified ID
preview.previewApplicationMode: Read-only site renderer; disable admin/API writes, read immutable content only
preview.visiblePublicationAuthority: D1 collaboration_publications CAS pointer, consumed by the authenticated preview viewer; no alias advance in preparation

identity.publicMetadataVerified: restricted enrollment, mailbox proof required, 900-second proof TTL
identity.enrollmentMethod: Issue three exact-email admission records using the existing enrollment invitations API; no email is sent by issuance
identity.activation: Verify live ENROLLMENT_INVITATIONS_ENABLED and enable only that reviewed invitation mode if disabled; never enable public enrollment or replace unrelated allowlists
identity.userFlow: After preview acceptance and separate notification authorization, each person self-starts /v1/auth/enrollment/start and completes mailbox proof at /v1/auth/enrollment/complete, then signs into Client Workspace

credentialPlan.identityAdmission: Use existing authorized Identity service deputy with enrollment_invitation_manage. If none exists, approve one narrow deputy through the existing secure secret manager; revoke after admissions. Never expose it to the client or model.
credentialPlan.agent: Short-lived project/task-bound application grant for context read and proposal create only; 15-minute maximum, one proposal, member revocation enforced; no human session token in model/MCP arguments, no approval/deploy scopes. Issue only after resource audience and adapter acceptance are verified.
credentialPlan.git: Use ephemeral repository workflow GITHUB_TOKEN for createsomethingtoday/create-something-monorepo with contents:write only in the protected preview job; adapter restricts commit parent, one manifest path and collab-<job-uuid> ref. Platform permission is repository-wide, not path-scoped; protected workflow enforces narrowing.
credentialPlan.pages: One server/CI-only MAVERICK_PREVIEW_PAGES_TOKEN with Account / Cloudflare Pages / Edit in account 9645bd52e640b8a4f40a3a55ff1dd75a, held in the protected preview environment. Pages permission is broader than a branch/project: approval must acknowledge that breadth; fixed project/branch validation is mandatory. No production or general tool endpoint receives the token.
credentialPlan.runtimeStorage: Use Worker D1/KV bindings, not REST D1/KV API tokens. No runtime Cloudflare account token and no new model API key.
credentialPlan.provisioning: Use Micah's existing operator session only for the approved named resource/binding/migration changes; do not copy it into runtime or CI. Credential values stay in native secure setup, never chat, source, logs or screenshots.

acceptanceBeforeTeamNotification: Source review, normal commit gates and CI pass without secret-scan bypass

Actual Claude/Codex task-scoped proposal round trip with existing authorized provider session and no API billing fallback
Human approved edit produces one immutable Git/Pages/KV result, verified independently from provider metadata
Unknown outcome retry reconciles by job ID; stale/concurrent jobs cannot replace the D1 publication winner
Authenticated preview viewer serves the exact publication version and fails closed on missing/hash-mismatched content
Production and original preview alias/bindings unchanged; production action requires separate Micah exact-version/target approval
